game_title: Discount Rules – Net Menders' Pier Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier, a pier of net menders: the deckhand must handle pirate raiders while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Discount Rules: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount.
theme: Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier: a pier of net menders
core_gameplay_loop: In Net Menders' Pier, repeat each round: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount. Each round, pirate raiders strike the harbor gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the profit value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the harbor gate from pirate raiders in Net Menders' Pier: keep the profit meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 59-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: profit drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 59-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 5 (applied tier): Discount Rules
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how profit changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against pirate raiders in Net Menders' Pier.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 59 seconds while profit > 0.
